connector_scope.meaning: Use retail factory-made structural brackets at the converted joints. Ordinary through-bolts may fasten a bracket but may not replace it with a direct wood-to-wood lap joint. Do not turn plain steel stock into a connector design or release fabrication by treating its ASTM grade as authorization.

frame_change_scope.clarified_question: May I change other hidden frame members as needed for a factory-connector design, while preserving the climbing surface and the 66 panel/kicker screw locations?
frame_change_scope.meaning: The earlier center-support-only preference no longer limits the separate bolted candidate. Preserve the selected baseline, climbing surface, panel outlines, and all 66 panel/kicker screw axes. Check the actual kerf-right kicker edge support. This is design-scope permission, not acceptance of any connector, lumber change, calculation, purchase, or drilling schedule.
